cards.text: Josiah, king of Judah, has just died after archers wounded him in battle (2 Chronicles 35:23-24). Now Judah needs a new king. The people of the land take Jehoahaz, son of Josiah, and make him king in Jerusalem in place of his father.

Jehoahaz is twenty-three when he becomes king, and he reigns in Jerusalem three MONTHS. Friend, that's not a reign, that's a FREE TRIAL, and it ends when the king of Egypt dethrones him and makes Judah pay a levy of silver and gold.

cards.question: Jehoahaz has just been dethroned in Jerusalem. So who puts the next king on Judah's throne?

cards.text: Neco, king of Egypt, makes Eliakim, brother of Jehoahaz, king over Judah and Jerusalem. New crown AND a new name: Eliakim is now Jehoiakim.

cards.question: Neco doesn't leave Jehoahaz in Jerusalem. He carries Jehoahaz off to ___.

cards.text: Jehoiakim is twenty-five when he becomes king, and he reigns in Jerusalem eleven years. After his brother's three months, ELEVEN YEARS is a lifetime achievement award!

cards.question: King Jehoiakim does what is right in the sight of the LORD his God.

cards.text: Then Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, comes up against Jehoiakim. He binds him with bronze shackles to take him to Babylon.

cards.question: Nebuchadnezzar also takes something else from Jerusalem to Babylon. What is it?

answers.text: Some articles from the house of the LORD
Some stones from the wall of Jerusalem
Some gates from the city of Jerusalem

cards.question: Nebuchadnezzar puts the articles from the house of the LORD in his palace in Babylon.

cards.text: Nebuchadnezzar puts those articles in his temple in Babylon. The rest of Jehoiakim's story, abominations and all, is written in the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah, and his son Jehoiachin reigns in his place.

cards.question: Jehoiachin, the new king, does evil in the sight of the LORD, just like his father Jehoiakim.
Jehoiachin is eighteen when he becomes king in Jerusalem, and he reigns there ___ months and ten days.

cards.text: In the spring, King Nebuchadnezzar summons Jehoiachin and brings him to Babylon, along with the articles of value from the house of the LORD.

cards.question: Jehoiachin is gone to Babylon, and Judah needs a new king. Who makes Jehoiachin's relative Zedekiah king over Judah and Jerusalem?

cards.text: Zedekiah is twenty-one when he becomes king, and he reigns in Jerusalem eleven years. He does evil in the sight of the LORD his God, and the LORD has a prophet speaking for Him: Jeremiah.

cards.question: King Zedekiah humbles himself before Jeremiah the prophet.

cards.text: Here's the thing. King Nebuchadnezzar had made Zedekiah swear by God.

cards.question: King Nebuchadnezzar made Zedekiah swear by God. How does Zedekiah treat King Nebuchadnezzar?

answers.text: He keeps his oath to him
He asks him for an army

cards.text: Zedekiah stiffens his neck and hardens his heart against turning to the LORD, the God of Israel. Friend, I've seen cookies forgotten on the cooling rack for a WEEK that were softer than that.

The leaders of the priests and the people multiply their unfaithful deeds and defile the house of the LORD. And still, again and again, the LORD, the God of their fathers, sends word to His people through His messengers.

cards.question: Why does the LORD keep sending messengers to His people again and again?

answers.text: They asked Him for a sign

cards.question: The LORD keeps sending messengers to His people. How do the people treat those messengers?

answers.text: They mock and scoff at them

cards.text: They keep despising His words until the wrath of the LORD against His people is stirred up beyond remedy. So He brings up the king of the Chaldeans against them.

cards.question: God gives His people all into the hand of the king of the Chaldeans, ___.

cards.text: Young men are put to the sword in the sanctuary, sparing neither young nor old. Nebuchadnezzar carries off everything to Babylon, from the articles of the house of God to the treasures of the king and his officials.

cards.question: The Chaldeans set fire to the house of God.

cards.text: They break down the wall of Jerusalem and burn down all the palaces. Those who escaped the sword are carried off to Babylon to serve Nebuchadnezzar and his sons.

cards.question: The exiles stay servants to Nebuchadnezzar and his sons until the kingdom of ___ comes to power.
Back home, the land enjoys its Sabbath rest all the days of the desolation, until ___ years are completed, fulfilling the word of the LORD spoken through Jeremiah.

cards.text: Now it's the first year of Cyrus, king of Persia, and the word of the LORD spoken through Jeremiah is about to be fulfilled.

cards.question: Cyrus, king of Persia, sends a proclamation throughout his kingdom and puts it in writing. Who stirred his spirit to do it?
In his proclamation, Cyrus says the LORD, the God of heaven, has given him all the kingdoms of the earth. What does Cyrus say the LORD appointed him to do?

answers.text: Build Him a house at Jerusalem

cards.question: Cyrus tells anyone who belongs to the LORD's people that they may go up.
